svg.title: For the determinant arm choose Ps(0) = A −I, Ps(1) = pad(I + s(A −I)), and Ps(j) = −error(I + s(A −I)) for j ≥2. Its order-n label has n+3 hops, so its sum restores the local integrated intensity at grade n+1, retaining n+1 discrepancy factors. For the source arm choose Ps(0) = flawed(A) and Ps(j) = −s flawed(A) for j ≥1. Its order-n label has n+1 hops and restores the corresponding integrated grade-n note. These are exact scalar identities; the finite color trace belongs inside each arm label. Q If each factor has entry bound lj, the absolute stamp is at most Rk+1 j<k lj.
